title: Shared radial factor for two particles at rest, initial separation 6 to 9: one table G(r) and a 0.95 factor for pairs with C

claims.statement: Two particles at rest, species X and Y from A, B, C, initial separation r0 in [6, 9], duration T <= 6. Each particle accelerates toward (K > 0) or away from (K < 0) its partner with magnitude |K| / r^2.5 at the current separation (chamber and time units, P = 2.5), with K held fixed over the run: K_XY(r0) = K5_XY x G(r0) x (0.9475 if C is X or Y). K5 are the P-0005 separation-5 coefficients (K_A(A) 18.0, K_A(B) 8.99, K_B(A) 12.34, K_A(C) -8.77, K_C(A) -21.25, K_B(B) 6.12, K_C(C) 12.36, K_B(C) -6.10, K_C(B) -10.59). The radial factor is G(r0) = 1.51 - 0.092 r0, so G(6) = 0.958, G(7) = 0.866, G(8) = 0.774, G(9) = 0.682. Fitted by lab-keystone to 15 far-field runs; residual error at tracker noise (RMSE/10 from 0.0047 to 0.0054 on those runs). The fit is in-sample; the round-1 pre-registered runs are the out-of-sample test.
